correctness.rationale: For n=2m+1≥5, the subcomplex cover by admissible first-coordinate adjunctions is complete. Intersections collapse through extensive/reductive face-poset maps to Ferrers sets, then to the simplex on C_* using the maximal possible b. Feasibility of J is exactly containment in m consecutive labels, proved by a directed 3-cycle witness in both directions. The open-arc circle cover has that same nerve and contractible intersections; natural cyclic nerve equivalences with free isotropy give the C_n-equivariant S1 equivalence. Integral H0,H1, quotient circle and n-fold H1 map follow; n=3 is excluded. Independently re-enumerated cells and every nerve subset for n=5 and n=7; Euler=0. This is analytical all-odd proof, not extrapolation.
